title: Sets with null rotated coordinate projections are null for the mass measure (Simon 6, Remark 2.35, Lemma 2.36, Remark 2.37(2))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ D_n(U) with M_W(T) + M_W(∂T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with IsMassMeasure T μ. Let Q be a linear isometry of ℝ^P and E ⊆ ℝ^P a Borel set such that Lⁿ(p_α(Q(E))) = 0 for every α ∈ I(n,P), where p_α : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ, x ↦ (x^{α(1)}, …, x^{α(n)}), and Lⁿ is Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝⁿ. Then μ(E) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ → ∀ (Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P) (E : Set (Eucl P)), MeasurableSet E → (∀ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Q x (α i)) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' E) = 0) → μ E = 0
